create_logger: create an in-memory Logger instance that stores logging data in a Python list
build_logger_write: build a Logger and call write() to append a mapping of key-value pairs to the internal data list
test_logger_df: test the Logger's df property to convert the internal data list into a pandas DataFrame
refactor_wrap_problem: refactor wrap_problem to wrap a TestbedProblem with the in-memory Logger for logging
review_logger: review the Logger class that extends logging_base.Logger and provides in-memory data storage
